+-- The frozen assignment-value entry (language_parser:3700): one newline and
+-- one lexer-owned indent open a value. The value's first token owns its anchor.
+-- This is an expression, never a statement block or a header continuation.
+import:
+	../tables/token: TokenKind(NewlineToken, IndentToken, DedentToken)
+	parse_state: ParseState, current_kind, advanced
+
+
+pure func next_line_value_entry(state: ParseState) -> Option[ParseState]:
+	if state.current_kind() == NewlineToken and state.advanced().current_kind() == IndentToken:
+		Some(state.advanced().advanced())
+	else:
+		None
+
+
+-- Pipe strings end their own line, so they arrive directly at DEDENT. Other
+-- expressions leave a NEWLINE. Consume only the value's own closing layout;
+-- a second value line is safely declined, not read as another statement.
+pure func close_next_line_value(state: ParseState) -> Option[ParseState]:
+	var closing = state
+	while closing.current_kind() == NewlineToken:
+		closing = closing.advanced()
+	if closing.current_kind() == DedentToken:
+		Some(closing.advanced())
+	else:
+		None
